# S565 — say in the UI brief that a go test -run pattern must not contain a pipe and offer a form that is allowed

**Findings:**  · **Size:**  · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

The ui role reported this as tool feedback (friction) in ork run ork-20261125-153042-530c, item S547. It ran `go -C ... test -run MatrixCopy|RenderCLIViews ./internal/cli` and the permission check denied it as "multiple operations". An unquoted `|` makes the command a compound command, and the UI pass runs on a one-plain-command rule. The UI brief tells the role to run `go test ./internal/cli -run TestRenderCLIViews -renders DIR` (`internal/engine/brief.go:216-220`). It says nothing about how to name more than one test, so the role reached for a pipe.

The brief should say that a `go test -run` pattern must not contain a pipe. It should give a form that is allowed: one test per command, or a pattern with no pipe that the tests share. Only the UI role's brief changes. The text goes in as its own section inside the `in.Role == RoleUI` block of `BuildBrief`.
